name: trustid
description: TrustID V1 — Identity and Trust Infrastructure

scripts.build: npm run build -w @trustid/shared && npm run build -w @trustid/zk && npm run build -w @trustid/bbs-sdk && npm run build -w @trustid/baas-sdk && npm run build -w @trustid/device-security && npm run build -w @trustid/vault-sdk && npm run build -w @trustid/ui-react && npm run build -w @trustid/sovereign-crypto && npm run build -w @trustid/api && npm run build -w @trustid/web && npm run build -w @trustid/mock-lifeos && npm run build -w @trustid/device
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w @trustid/shared && npm run build -w @trustid/zk && npm run build -w @trustid/bbs-sdk && npm run build -w @trustid/baas-sdk && npm run build -w @trustid/sdk && npm run build -w @trustid/sovereign-crypto && node scripts/sync-prisma-provider.mjs && npm run db:generate -w @trustid/api && npm run build -w @trustid/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @trustid/shared && npm run build -w @trustid/zk && npm run build -w @trustid/baas-sdk && npm run build -w @trustid/device-security && npm run build -w @trustid/vault-sdk && npm run build -w @trustid/ui-react && npm run build -w @trustid/sovereign-crypto && node scripts/sync-prisma-provider.mjs && npm run db:generate -w @trustid/api && npm run build -w @trustid/api && node scripts/prepare-netlify-db.mjs && npm run build -w @trustid/web
scripts.start: node scripts/sync-prisma-provider.mjs && npm run db:push -w @trustid/api && npm run db:seed -w @trustid/api && npm run start -w @trustid/api
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run build -w @trustid/shared && npm run build -w @trustid/zk && npm run build -w @trustid/bbs-sdk && npm run build -w @trustid/baas-sdk && npm run build -w @trustid/device-security && npm run build -w @trustid/sovereign-crypto && npm run db:generate && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
scripts.test: npm run test -w @trustid/api && npm run test -w @trustid/vault-sdk && npm run test -w @trustid/ui-react
